keyboard_layout.label: Keyboard layout
keyboard_layout.description: Which gaming key cluster to draw. Custom uses the key list below.

custom_keys.label: Custom keys
custom_keys.description: Keys shown in the custom layout, in reading order. Use names such as W, A, S, D, SPACE, SHIFT, CTRL, TAB or ESC.

show_keyboard.label: Show keyboard
show_keyboard.description: Draw the keyboard cluster in the overlay.

show_mouse.label: Show mouse
show_mouse.description: Draw the mouse button pad in the overlay.

show_key_labels.label: Show key labels
show_key_labels.description: Draw the key name on each keycap.

show_mouse_labels.label: Show mouse labels
show_mouse_labels.description: Draw LMB, RMB, MMB and side-button labels on the mouse.

scale.label: Scale
scale.description: Overall size of the overlay contents.

key_size.label: Key size
key_size.description: Height of a single keycap in logical pixels.

key_gap.label: Key gap
key_gap.description: Space between keycaps in logical pixels.

overlay_gap.label: Section gap
overlay_gap.description: Space between the keyboard cluster and the mouse pad.

overlay_padding.label: Panel padding
overlay_padding.description: Inner padding of the overlay panel.

overlay_radius.label: Panel radius
overlay_radius.description: Corner radius of the overlay panel background.

overlay_opacity.label: Overlay opacity
overlay_opacity.description: Opacity of the whole overlay, including labels and effects.

overlay_background.label: Panel background
overlay_background.description: Draw the black overlay panel behind the keyboard and mouse.

overlay_background_color.label: Panel colour
overlay_background_color.description: Panel fill colour. Hex values match the reference; palette roles are also accepted.

overlay_border_color.label: Panel border colour
overlay_border_color.description: Cyan frame colour around the overlay. Set the border width to 0 to hide it.

overlay_border_width.label: Panel border width
overlay_border_width.description: Width of the panel border in logical pixels.

key_idle_color.label: Keycap fill
key_idle_color.description: Fill colour of an unpressed keycap.

key_border_width.label: Key border width
key_border_width.description: Width of keycap borders in logical pixels.

key_text_color.label: Key label colour
key_text_color.description: Colour of the key labels when the key is not pressed.

accent_color.label: Pressed fill
accent_color.description: Neon fill for pressed keys, mouse buttons and the mouse wheel.

accent_text_color.label: Pressed label colour
accent_text_color.description: Label colour inside a pressed key or mouse button.

glow_color.label: Glow colour
glow_color.description: Palette role or hex colour for the press glow.

effects_glow.label: Glow effect
effects_glow.description: Show a soft glow around pressed keys and mouse buttons.

effects_ripple.label: Click ripple
effects_ripple.description: Fade the glow out briefly after a key or button is released.

mouse_pad_width.label: Mouse pad width
mouse_pad_width.description: Width of the rectangular mouse pad in logical pixels.

mouse_pad_height.label: Mouse pad height
mouse_pad_height.description: Height of the rectangular mouse pad in logical pixels.

mouse_pad_color.label: Mouse pad colour
mouse_pad_color.description: Palette role or hex colour for the mouse pad.

mouse_pad_opacity.label: Mouse pad opacity
mouse_pad_opacity.description: Opacity of the mouse pad background.

mouse_border_color.label: Mouse outline
mouse_border_color.description: Outline colour of the mouse body and buttons.

mouse_border_width.label: Mouse border width
mouse_border_width.description: Width of mouse and button outlines in logical pixels.

mouse_show_wheel.label: Show wheel
mouse_show_wheel.description: Draw the scroll wheel and its middle-button click.

mouse_show_extra.label: Show side buttons
mouse_show_extra.description: Draw up to three side buttons reported by the selected mouse.

keyboard_device.label: Keyboard device fallback
keyboard_device.description: Optional device name or event path used until a device is chosen in the device picker.

mouse_device.label: Mouse device fallback
mouse_device.description: Optional device name or event path used until a device is chosen in the device picker.

background.label: Background
background.description: Let Noctalia draw the desktop-card background.

background_color.label: Background colour
background_color.description: Palette role or hex colour for the card background.

background_radius.label: Background radius
background_radius.description: Corner radius of the card background.

background_padding.label: Background padding
background_padding.description: Inner padding of the card background.

show_card_settings.label: Card content settings
show_card_settings.description: Show the title, status and settings-button options.

card_title.label: Card title
card_title.description: Title shown above the live preview.

show_card_status.label: Show card status
show_card_status.description: Show the input-reader and device status under the preview.

show_card_settings_button.label: Show settings button
show_card_settings_button.description: Show a button that opens this plugin's settings.

bar_glyph.label: Bar glyph
bar_glyph.description: Glyph shown in the bar widget.

bar_show_label.label: Show bar label
bar_show_label.description: Show a short text label next to the glyph.

bar_label.label: Bar label
bar_label.description: Text shown next to the bar glyph.

bar_highlight_active.label: Highlight active input
bar_highlight_active.description: Tint the bar glyph when a key or mouse button is pressed.

show_styling.label: Styling
show_styling.description: Show the colour and effect options.

show_scaling.label: Scaling
show_scaling.description: Show the size and label-scale options.

content_width.label: Widget width
content_width.description: Width of the desktop widget in logical pixels. The image keeps its aspect ratio.

mouse_size.label: Mouse height
mouse_size.description: Height of the mouse silhouette in the drawing.

label_scale.label: Label scale
label_scale.description: Scale key and mouse labels independently of the keycap size.

show_layout_section.label: Layout
show_layout_section.description: Show keyboard layout and size settings.

show_appearance_section.label: Appearance
show_appearance_section.description: Show panel, colour and effect settings.

show_scaling_section.label: Scaling
show_scaling_section.description: Show key, mouse and label size settings.

mouse_body_color.label: Mouse fill
mouse_body_color.description: Fill colour for the mouse body, buttons and wheel.

mouse_body_opacity.label: Mouse body opacity
mouse_body_opacity.description: Opacity of the mouse body and button fills. Set to 0 for an outline-only mouse.

motion_arrow_size.label: Arrow size
motion_arrow_size.description: Line width and arrowhead size of the motion arrow.

motion_arrow_scale.label: Arrow length scale
motion_arrow_scale.description: Maximum arrow length inside the mouse body. 1.0 uses the full body length.

motion_arrow_color.label: Arrow colour
motion_arrow_color.description: Colour of the motion arrow. The glow still uses the accent colour.

motion_dot_size.label: Anchor dot size
motion_dot_size.description: Base radius of the centre pivot dot.

motion_dot_scale.label: Anchor dot scale
motion_dot_scale.description: Multiplier for the centre pivot dot radius.

motion_dot_color.label: Anchor dot colour
motion_dot_color.description: Fill colour of the centre pivot dot.

motion_arrow_idle.label: Arrow idle time
motion_arrow_idle.description: How long the arrow holds its last direction and length after the mouse stops, before fading.

motion_direction.label: Arrow direction
motion_direction.description: Auto uses screen-centre direction and falls back to mouse movement when the cursor is locked by a game.

panel.title: Keyboard & Mouse
panel.permission_body: Reading a keyboard or mouse requires a one-time udev rule for the selected device. The rule grants read access only to that device for the active user; no root daemon is used.
panel.permission_command: Run this after selecting a keyboard and mouse:
panel.permission_ok: Permission looks available for the selected devices.
panel.permission_missing: The selected device is selected but not readable yet. Apply the udev rule, then replug the device or log out and back in.
panel.no_devices: No keyboard or mouse devices were reported. Make sure the input reader is running and the udev rule is applied.
panel.saved: Device selection saved. The reader is restarting.
panel.save_failed: Could not save the device selection: {error}
panel.pending: Select a keyboard and a mouse to create a narrow udev rule.

errors.permission: Permission denied while opening {device}. Apply the udev rule and replug the device.
errors.no_devices: No readable input devices. Check the udev rule or whether the device is connected.
errors.python: python3 is required to read input devices.
errors.helper: The bundled input helper is missing.
errors.unknown: The input reader reported an error.
